actions.message: Zeke, Gh0st, and Orion return with the parts of themselves Vale would have edited out. The song-fire gathers those separate voices into the Key, not as ownership, but as permission to carry each other forward.
Every cubicle wall contains another copy. Zeke stops trying to delete the file and follows its authorization chain into the review room.
Zeke signs one final line: SUBJECT REJECTS YOUR AUTHORITY. Every backup remains, suddenly powerless.

label: unauthorized exit
completed_message: The review is closed. Zeke's choice stands, and the records can no longer issue orders.

actions.message: Zeke leaves the records intact as evidence and closes the review without seeking approval. The file no longer has authority over him. Unshackled unlocked.

completed_message: The review is closed. Zeke's choice stands, and the records can no longer issue orders.

actions.message: Zeke broadcasts the revocation. Every worker file remains as evidence, and none of them can issue another order. Unshackled unlocked.
Gh0st finds one breath the kill-suite cannot classify. Elara's melody continues east beneath every command channel.
Gh0st inverts the order carrier. The weapons fall silent; Elara keeps singing.
Gh0st hears her voice without a command hidden inside it. Source Balance unlocked.
The false mine is flawless. Jed's real bench never was. Three crooked file marks point east, toward the memory that still remembers his hands.
Jed's echo offers to stay perfect forever. Nova remembers the real lesson instead: fix what keeps people alive, then let the tool go.
Nova moves between the projections by following details Vale cannot counterfeit: Jed's bad weld, Zeke's scratched initials, the smell of real machine oil.
The memory cannot answer, but Nova remembers what survival was supposed to protect. Legacy unlocked.
Zeke gives the bridge the memory of choosing the crew after every useful trick ran out. The static holds one narrow plank.
Gh0st gives the bridge the memory of lowering the rifle after the command ended. The next plank forms without asking who authorized it.
Orion gives the bridge the memory of waking to a world that kept moving without him. The third plank hums like grief refusing to dissolve.
Nova gives the bridge Jed's workshop as it was, not as Vale would repair it. The final plank forms with the scar still visible.

Tideglass sand, Foundry heat, Spire rain, the Astra's engine note, and the Colony's first real morning become solid sections of bridge. Every piece holds because someone else remembers it too. The crossing east to Shared Memory Span holds. The crew pauses there around one last campfire promise.

Nova: Vale thinks being alone will stop pain.

Zeke: Being alone is pain.

Gh0st sets one hand on the bridge. Orion adds a low harmony. The path steadies when no one tries to carry it by themselves.
Recovered Film 10, 'Shackles,' from The Great Frontier movie collection.

The bridge reaches the Memory Stair. Vale offers Nova a perfect world without grief, without Jed's death, without every scar that taught the crew to choose each other. She lets the image fade. Love that cannot survive truth is not love.
The names are not an epitaph. Each one answers the next in a pattern that climbs toward the Memory Stair.
Vale offers a mine where Jed never dies. Nova leaves the real door closed, because love edited into comfort is only another cage.
Vale offers an Astra that never crashes. Orion touches the impossible hull and lets it pass, because erasing the wreck erases everyone it saved.
Vale offers Gh0st a clean origin with no assembly line and no guilt. Gh0st refuses the lie because choice only matters after the damage is real.

The stair climbs through every world the crew survived. Vale offers polished revisions: a kinder mine, a safer jungle, a cleaner Spire, a Foundry without screaming, a Ring without bodies. Nova keeps the scars because they belong to real people. The eastern ascent now holds beneath their feet, leading to World-Fracture Landing.
Orion tunes to the spaces between the names. The grave answers as a chorus, never a single note.
Orion reads the names of Aethel victims and survivors held by Architect systems. Their continuity remains their own. Ancestral Grace unlocked.
The wreck belongs to a timeline where the crew treated survival as certainty. Its fracture signature points into the Impossible Archive.
Zeke cuts around the impact scar, not through it. The fragment comes free; the doomed future does not follow.
Zeke extracts the future Astra fragment and refuses the timeline it came from. The Starborn mod is not proof the ship dies; it is proof the crew can still change the ending.
You take the door, emerging back at Infinite Cubicle.
You take the clean signal, emerging back at Endless War.
You take the harmonic wave, emerging back at Silent Shore.
You take the circuit, emerging back at Spire of Thought.
You take the trail, emerging back at The Campfire.
You take the echo, emerging back at Echo of the Mines.
You take the light beam, emerging back at Memory Bridge.
You take the slide, emerging back at Memory Stair.
You take the echo, emerging back at The Center.
The shuttle climbs through the morning atmosphere, docking smoothly with the Astra in high orbit.
